facts.fact: Malawi's Department of Climate Change and Meteorological Services says it uses the Flash Flood Guidance System, which integrates satellite rainfall estimates with ground observations and hydrological models, to produce real-time flash flood risk maps.

Malawi's Department of Climate Change and Meteorological Services says it issues flash flood warnings generated with tools including the Flash Flood Guidance System, which uses satellite rainfall estimates.
